status: PROTOTYPE runtime derivatives of two NEW iteration02 native F16 SV masters (turnstile, supply crate). Unapproved, gameReady false, not production art, no license clearance asserted. Dimensions provisional.

source.generationMode: local native F16 SV 1024, 24 steps/flow, seed 42, GSS 10, FoV 20

conditioningImage.generator: Codex native built-in image_gen (tools.image_gen__imagegen, Extension kind image_gen.generation)

transform.description: p_out = scale * R * p_source + translation (baked into vertices; node transform identity). R rows = output X,Y,Z axes in source coordinates, from the levelled box frame.
transform.orientationEvidence: Native SV mesh keeps the elevated conditioning-camera pose (22.7 deg tilt from source +Y). Levelled via the dominant box-face frame; long cabinet axis -> Z with the card-reader end (image right, nearest the camera) at +Z; X = Y x Z (no mirror). Render check: qa-artifacts/assets/props-iteration02/turnstile-derived.png shows a level cabinet, reader on top at +Z, three arms on -X with one horizontal.
transform.origin: bottom centre (y=0 floor contact; x/z bbox centre)

measurements.layout: Cabinet long axis = local Z (walking direction); +Z end carries the card reader (entry end in the conditioning image). Arms + rotor hub on the -X side of the cabinet; the horizontal arm blocks the lane on -X. Bbox centre (origin) is offset from the cabinet centre toward -X by the arm reach.
measurements.method: Output-space dense vertices: cabinet footprint from vertices below 0.30 m; arms = vertices >2 cm outside the cabinet x-range.

pipeline.tool: lib/bake.mjs (closest same-facing dense surface; colour, metallic-roughness, tangent normal)

pipeline.detail: box frame from area-weighted dominant face normals (undoes the single-view camera pitch/yaw), up = frame axis nearest source +Y, front chosen per asset (orientationEvidence); uniform scale + bottom-centre origin baked into vertices
baseColor JPEG, metallicRoughness JPEG, normal PNG; plain glTF 2.0 binary, no extensions

limitations: Single-view AI reconstruction: back/underside/hidden surfaces and texture are inferred, not designed.
Simplified from 968112 to 5974 triangles; thin parts lose geometric detail; fine relief approximated by the baked normal map.
Provisional real-world scale chosen by this pipeline, not measured or approved.
Prototype derivative: unapproved, gameReady false; no commercial/model license clearance asserted.
